key: FERN: Great, we can all get on with our lives now.
en: FERN: Great, we can all get on with our lives now.
ja: ファーン: よし、これでみんな自分の人生に戻れるってわけだ。

key: Now that you've had your moment.
en: Now that you've had your moment.
ja: お前の見せ場も終わったことだしな。

key: But whatever.
en: But whatever.
ja: まあ、どうでもいいけど。

key: I guess it's just gonna be like that.
en: I guess it's just gonna be like that.
ja: まあ、そんなもんなんだろうよ。

key: But thanks,
en: But thanks,
ja: でも、ありがとよ、

key: I guess.
en: I guess.
ja: ってことにしとく。

key: Thanks for the assist, \PN.
en: Thanks for the assist, \PN.
ja: 手伝ってくれて助かったぜ、\PN。

key: Despite everything before, you're pretty solid.
en: Despite everything before, you're pretty solid.
ja: 前のことは色々あったが、お前、なかなかやるじゃねえか。

key: Thanks for the assist, I guess.
en: Thanks for the assist, I guess.
ja: 手伝ってくれて、まあ助かったってことで。

key: I'm gonna be the bigger person and keep on smiling despite all this.
en: I'm gonna be the bigger person and keep on smiling despite all this.
ja: こんなことがあっても、オレ様は大人の対応で笑っといてやるよ。

key: ...But anyway, it looks like this operation's a bust.
en: ...But anyway, it looks like this operation's a bust.
ja: ……とにかく、この作戦は失敗みたいだな。

key: That Mew is slippery, and...
en: That Mew is slippery, and...
ja: あのミュウ、すばしっこすぎるし、それに……

key: Well, I guess I messed this one up.
en: Well, I guess I messed this one up.
ja: まあ、今回はしくじったってことか。

key: My bad, \PN.
en: My bad, \PN.
ja: 悪かったな、\PN。

key: Maybe next time.
en: Maybe next time.
ja: また次だな。

key: I'll see you back at the Nightclub.
en: I'll see you back at the Nightclub.
ja: ナイトクラブでまた会おうぜ。

key: You wanna head back already too?
en: You wanna head back already too?
ja: お前ももう戻りたいのか?

key: We're obviously not getting anything else here.
en: We're obviously not getting anything else here.
ja: 見りゃわかるが、ここでこれ以上何も得られねえだろ。

key: FERN: Let's get a move on.
en: FERN: Let's get a move on.
ja: ファーン: さっさと行くぞ。

key: FERN: Sure, of course you'd have your own stuff still.
en: FERN: Sure, of course you'd have your own stuff still.
ja: ファーン: ああ、そうだよな、お前にはまだやることがあるんだろ。

key: See ya.
en: See ya.
ja: またな。

key: FERN: I think I see the switch right behind you...
en: FERN: I think I see the switch right behind you...
ja: ファーン: お前のすぐ後ろにスイッチが見えるんだが……

key: If you could just... flip that...
en: If you could just... flip that...
ja: それを、その……押してくれると……

key: That'd be cool.
en: That'd be cool.
ja: 助かるんだけどな。

key: FERN: ...
en: FERN: ...
ja: ファーン: ……

key: All right, I know.
en: All right, I know.
ja: わかったよ、わかった。

key: This is payback for what happened in Rhodochrine.
en: This is payback for what happened in Rhodochrine.
ja: これはロドクラインでの仕返しってわけだな。

key: And you know what?
en: And you know what?
ja: で、知ってるか?

key: You're entitled to that.
en: You're entitled to that.
ja: お前にはその権利がある。

key: So, go ahead, let it out; have your laugh, your moment, sure.
en: So, go ahead, let it out; have your laugh, your moment, sure.
ja: だから、いいぜ、出しちまえ。笑いたきゃ笑え、見せ場を作りたきゃ作れ。

key: And then come back and let me out.
en: And then come back and let me out.
ja: で、そのあと戻ってきて、オレ様を出してくれ。

key: Yeah?
en: Yeah?
ja: だろ?

key: What are you even doing this for, huh?
en: What are you even doing this for, huh?
ja: 一体何のためにこんなことしてんだよ、あ?

key: Can't you just let me out?
en: Can't you just let me out?
ja: さっさと出してくれねえのか?

key: What'd I ever do to you?
en: What'd I ever do to you?
ja: お前に一体何をしたってんだ?

key: FERN: ...What, do you want me to get on my knees and beg?
en: FERN: ...What, do you want me to get on my knees and beg?
ja: ファーン: ……何だよ、オレ様に膝をついて懇願してほしいのか?

key: Beg like you did?
en: Beg like you did?
ja: お前がやったみたいにか?

key: Even you eventually refused to do that.
en: Even you eventually refused to do that.
ja: お前でさえ、最終的にはそれを拒んだくせに。

key: Are you really gonna make me do it now?
en: Are you really gonna make me do it now?
ja: 本当に今、オレ様にそれをやらせる気か?

key: Is this what you're into?
en: Is this what you're into?
ja: これがお前の好みなのかよ?

key: This really the only way we're gonna do this?
en: This really the only way we're gonna do this?
ja: 本当にこれしかやり方がねえのかよ?

key: FERN: You're really doing this to me, huh.
en: FERN: You're really doing this to me, huh.
ja: ファーン: マジでこれ、オレ様にやらせる気なんだな。

key: This level of pettiness is pretty cringe, but...
en: This level of pettiness is pretty cringe, but...
ja: こんな器の小さいこと、ドン引きもんだけどよ……

key: Whatever floats your boat, I guess.
en: Whatever floats your boat, I guess.
ja: まあ、お前がそれで満足するってんならな。

key: Fine, let's do it.
en: Fine, let's do it.
ja: いいぜ、やってやるよ。

key: O glorious savior \PN, I, Fern, prostrate myself before you in hopes of your mercy.
en: O glorious savior \PN, I, Fern, prostrate myself before you in hopes of your mercy.
ja: ああ栄光ある救世主\PNよ、このファーン、あなたの慈悲を望み、ひれ伏します。

key: Hear my plea and be generous in thy sentencing...
en: Hear my plea and be generous in thy sentencing...
ja: 我が懇願をお聞き届けの上、寛大なる裁きを……

key: FERN: Sigh...
en: FERN: Sigh...
ja: ファーン: はぁ……

key: You're really gonna have me go through the whole thing, huh.
en: You're really gonna have me go through the whole thing, huh.
ja: マジで最後までやらせる気なんだな。

key: Whatever.
en: Whatever.
ja: もういい。

key: I, Fern, admit that I am an inferior Trainer, battler, and person, to \PN.
en: I, Fern, admit that I am an inferior Trainer, battler, and person, to \PN.
ja: このファーン、\PNに対してトレーナーとしても、バトラーとしても、人としても劣っていることを認めます。

key: ...Isn't that enough?
en: ...Isn't that enough?
ja: ……これで十分だろ?

key: FERN: ...Sigh.
en: FERN: ...Sigh.
ja: ファーン: ……はぁ。

key: I, Fern, swear that I will never get in \PN's way, because I'm not worth the time it takes to step on me...
en: I, Fern, swear that I will never get in \PN's way, because I'm not worth the time it takes to step on me...
ja: このファーン、二度と\PNの邪魔をしないことを誓います。踏みつける時間をかける価値すらないので……

key: Can we be done?
en: Can we be done?
ja: もう終わりでいいか?

key: FERN: ...You are really pushing this too far, fam.
en: FERN: ...You are really pushing this too far, fam.
ja: ファーン: ……マジでやりすぎだろ、おい。

key: ...I, Fern, fully embrace the fact that I will NEVER be anywhere remotely near as cool, stylish, popular, talented, good-looking, or likable as \PN.
en: ...I, Fern, fully embrace the fact that I will NEVER be anywhere remotely near as cool, stylish, popular, talented, good-looking, or likable as \PN.
ja: ……このファーン、自分が\PNほどクールで、おしゃれで、人気があって、才能があって、見た目が良くて、好かれる人間には、絶対になれないという事実を、全面的に受け入れます。

key: Bet it's easy to feel secure in that one with my face like this, huh.
en: Bet it's easy to feel secure in that one with my face like this, huh.
ja: こんな顔してりゃ、そう思うのも簡単なんだろうよ、なあ。

key: Are we done now though?
en: Are we done now though?
ja: で、もう終わったのか?

key: We're good?
en: We're good?
ja: いいよな?

key: Got that out of your system?
en: Got that out of your system?
ja: それで気が済んだか?

key: Wanna call me 'princess' too while you're at it?
en: Wanna call me 'princess' too while you're at it?
ja: ついでにオレ様のことも「お姫サン」って呼びたいのか?

key: Or can we all finally go home now?
en: Or can we all finally go home now?
ja: それとも、もうみんな帰っていいのか?

key: FERN: Just open the damn door.
en: FERN: Just open the damn door.
ja: ファーン: いいから、そのクソ扉を開けろ。

key: A secret switch! Press it?
en: A secret switch! Press it?
ja: 隠しスイッチだ! 押す?

key: Who wouldn't?
en: Who wouldn't?
ja: 押さない理由がある?

key: Better not...
en: Better not...
ja: やめとこう……

key: A secret switch! It's already been pressed.
en: A secret switch! It's already been pressed.
ja: 隠しスイッチだ! もう押されている。

key: The Smeargle takes out a noteboard and begins writing on it.
en: The Smeargle takes out a noteboard and begins writing on it.
ja: ドーブルがノート板を取り出し、何かを書き始めた。

key: It shows it a moment later:
en: It shows it a moment later:
ja: 少し経って、それを見せてくる:

key: "human late"
en: "human late"
ja: 「人間 遅い」

key: "human go up"
en: "human go up"
ja: 「人間 上行く」

key: "bigman upside"
en: "bigman upside"
ja: 「でかポケ 上」

key: "bigman need quiet"
en: "bigman need quiet"
ja: 「でかポケ 静か必要」

key: "human give quiet???"
en: "human give quiet???"
ja: 「人間 静かにする???」

key: "human give quiet up"
en: "human give quiet up"
ja: 「人間 静かにする 上」

key: "human no give quiet???"
en: "human no give quiet???"
ja: 「人間 静かにしない???」

key: "why human no quiet?"
en: "why human no quiet?"
ja: 「なぜ人間 静かじゃない?」

key: "please human quiet bigman"
en: "please human quiet bigman"
ja: 「お願い 人間 静かに でかポケ」

key: "smeargle draw way"
en: "smeargle draw way"
ja: 「ドーブル 道 描く」

key: "follow numbers for bigman"
en: "follow numbers for bigman"
ja: 「でかポケのために 数字 追う」

key: Smeargle takes out its noteboard.
en: Smeargle takes out its noteboard.
ja: ドーブルがノート板を取り出す。

key: "human go"
en: "human go"
ja: 「人間 行く」

key: "bigman need hurry"
en: "bigman need hurry"
ja: 「でかポケ 急ぐ必要」

key: "bigman quiet now"
en: "bigman quiet now"
ja: 「でかポケ 今 静か」

key: "thank human good"
en: "thank human good"
ja: 「感謝 人間 いい」

key: "but other big still loud"
en: "but other big still loud"
ja: 「でも他の でかい やつ まだうるさい」

key: "smeargle help?"
en: "smeargle help?"
ja: 「ドーブル 手伝う?」

key: "smeargle help"
en: "smeargle help"
ja: 「ドーブル 手伝う」

key: "but smeargle not battle"
en: "but smeargle not battle"
ja: 「でもドーブル 戦わない」

key: "draw only"
en: "draw only"
ja: 「描くだけ」

key: "human word ????"
en: "human word ????"
ja: 「人間の言葉 ????」

key: "secrteary ???"
en: "secrteary ???"

key: "smeargle human secrteary"
en: "smeargle human secrteary"
ja: 「ドーブル 人間の ひしょ」

key: "smeargle go human go"
en: "smeargle go human go"
ja: 「ドーブル 行く 人間 行く」

key: "goodbye human"
en: "goodbye human"
ja: 「さよなら 人間」

key: "secrteary later"
en: "secrteary later"
ja: 「ひしょ また今度」

key: Shinx is trapped in the cage...
en: Shinx is trapped in the cage...
ja: コリンクがおりに閉じ込められている……

key: All right, little guy, you just stay put until the real prize comes out...
en: All right, little guy, you just stay put until the real prize comes out...
ja: よし、ちびっこ、本命が出てくるまでそこでじっとしてろよ……

key: Wait, who are you?!
en: Wait, who are you?!
ja: 待て、お前は誰だ?!

key: You're not too bad in a fight!
en: You're not too bad in a fight!
ja: やるじゃない、そこそこできるわね!

key: One down just like that?!
en: One down just like that?!
ja: こんなあっさり、一人やられたの?!

key: It didn't have to damage the cage so badly...
en: It didn't have to damage the cage so badly...
ja: おりをそこまでボロボロにしなくてもよかったのに……

key: Ugh...
en: Ugh...
ja: うぐ……

key: So the boss wants us to fall back?
en: So the boss wants us to fall back?
ja: ボスは撤退しろってこと?

key: I'll trust you for now, but if it turns out you're lying, I'll haunt your dreams at night.
en: I'll trust you for now, but if it turns out you're lying, I'll haunt your dreams at night.
ja: 今は信じておいてやるけど、うそだったってわかったら、夜な夜な夢に出てやるからね。

key: ...Relax, they told me they were going to look for help.
en: ...Relax, they told me they were going to look for help.
ja: ……落ち着いて、助けを探しに行くって言われてただけ。

key: I just didn't expect someone as frail as you.
en: I just didn't expect someone as frail as you.
ja: あんたみたいなひ弱そうなのが来るとは思ってなかっただけよ。

key: But I already lost, twice over, so I'll head out.
en: But I already lost, twice over, so I'll head out.
ja: でも、もう二回も負けたから、退散するわ。

key: If you're rounding up the others, be careful with Atreus.
en: If you're rounding up the others, be careful with Atreus.
ja: 他の連中を捕まえて回るなら、アトレウスには気をつけて。

key: He can be a bit of a flirt.
en: He can be a bit of a flirt.
ja: ちょっとナンパっぽいところがあるから。

key: You'll find him over on that big ruin monument thing in the middle of the place, you can't miss it.
en: You'll find him over on that big ruin monument thing in the middle of the place, you can't miss it.
ja: この場所の真ん中にある大きな遺跡の記念碑みたいなとこにいるから、すぐわかるわ。

key: Just go up four flights of stairs, down one flight and go to the farthest right side.
en: Just go up four flights of stairs, down one flight and go to the farthest right side.
ja: 階段を4階分上って、1階分下って、一番右端まで行けばいい。

key: For some reason someone graffitied those ruins with numbers and bright paint. Baby's first graffiti I'm guessing.
en: For some reason someone graffitied those ruins with numbers and bright paint. Baby's first graffiti I'm guessing.
ja: なぜかあの遺跡には、誰かが数字と派手な塗料で落書きしてるのよね。初めての落書きって感じの出来だけど。

key: I guess you've got the client to deal with still, huh.
en: I guess you've got the client to deal with still, huh.
ja: まだ依頼主の相手も残ってるってわけね。

key: Said she'd wait for us to corral it towards the northeast.
en: Said she'd wait for us to corral it towards the northeast.
ja: 北東の方に追い込んでくるのを待ってるって言ってたわ。

key: Good luck on that one-- I don't envy you.
en: Good luck on that one-- I don't envy you.
ja: 頑張って――あんたの立場、羨ましくないわ。

key: How did I only find a Geodude?!
en: How did I only find a Geodude?!
ja: なんでイシツブテしか見つからないのよ?!

key: I was supposed to find some cute, defenseless Electric Type, and well, this was technically one of those...
en: I was supposed to find some cute, defenseless Electric Type, and well, this was technically one of those...
ja: かわいくて無防備なでんきタイプを見つけるはずだったのに、まあ、一応それの一種っちゃそうだけど……

key: But a Geodude?
en: But a Geodude?
ja: でもイシツブテって?

key: What kind of Pokémon am I gonna trap with that?!
en: What kind of Pokémon am I gonna trap with that?!
ja: こんなのでどんなポケモンを捕まえろっていうのよ?!

key: Oh! I guess I might as well stop you from going any further too!
en: Oh! I guess I might as well stop you from going any further too!
ja: あ! ついでにあんたもここで止めておくべきよね!

key: Defeat is lonely and hard to bear...
en: Defeat is lonely and hard to bear...
ja: 敗北とは、孤独で耐え難いもの……

key: Darn, the prize was too fast!
en: Darn, the prize was too fast!
ja: ちぇっ、本命が速すぎたわ!

key: Or was I too slow...?
en: Or was I too slow...?
ja: それとも、あたしが遅すぎたのかしら……?

key: That's three strikes, huh?
en: That's three strikes, huh?
ja: これで三振ってわけね?

key: Wait, didn't you find Margo already?
en: Wait, didn't you find Margo already?
ja: 待って、もうマーゴを見つけたんじゃないの?

key: She was right near the exit!
en: She was right near the exit!
ja: 出口のすぐ近くにいたはずだけど!

key: The client isn't gonna be very happy about you coming, but oh well...
en: The client isn't gonna be very happy about you coming, but oh well...
ja: 依頼主は、あんたが来たことをあまり喜ばないでしょうけど、まあいいわ……

key: She's somewhere northeast of here... I think.
en: She's somewhere northeast of here... I think.
ja: 北東のどこかにいるはず……たぶん。

key: I'm sure you'll lose anyway!
en: I'm sure you'll lose anyway!
ja: どうせあんたが負けるに決まってるし!

key: After all, what is victory, but a goal out of reach?
en: After all, what is victory, but a goal out of reach?
ja: 何しろ、勝利なんて、しょせん手の届かない目標にすぎないでしょ?

key: I'll head back-- I know the way, don't worry-- so just forget about me, okay?
en: I'll head back-- I know the way, don't worry-- so just forget about me, okay?
ja: あたしは戻るわ――道はわかってるから心配しないで――だから、あたしのことは忘れていいから。

key: Lay down under my boot, beast!
en: Lay down under my boot, beast!
ja: あたしのブーツの下にひれ伏せ、けだもの!

key: #3, High Horsepower, now!
en: #3, High Horsepower, now!
ja: 3番、10まんばりき、今すぐ!

key: ???: Not so tough now, hm?
en: ???: Not so tough now, hm?
ja: ???: 今はそんなに強気じゃないみたいね?

key: ???: If this was all it took for you to capitulate, you should've saved us the trouble in the first place.
en: ???: If this was all it took for you to capitulate, you should've saved us the trouble in the first place.
ja: ???: これだけで降参するくらいなら、最初から手間をかけさせないでほしかったわ。

key: ???: Oh, what the hell?
en: ???: Oh, what the hell?
ja: ???: ああ、一体何なのよ?

key: I hired those grunts to do just a few simple tasks--
en: I hired those grunts to do just a few simple tasks--
ja: あのメテオ団員たちを雇ったのは、たった数個の単純な仕事のためだったのに――

key: Lure the Pokémon here, weaken it a bit, and to keep pests away.
en: Lure the Pokémon here, weaken it a bit, and to keep pests away.
ja: ポケモンをここに誘い込んで、少し弱らせて、邪魔者を追い払う、それだけ。

key: How hard is that?
en: How hard is that?
ja: それのどこが難しいっていうの?

key: I should've known not to hire scum from Orre.
en: I should've known not to hire scum from Orre.
ja: オーレのクズどもを雇うべきじゃなかったわね。

key: But those fools were the first team available, and with all the reports of Legendaries popping up in this region, I couldn't afford to wait...
en: But those fools were the first team available, and with all the reports of Legendaries popping up in this region, I couldn't afford to wait...
ja: でも、あの馬鹿どもが一番早く手配できたチームだったし、この地方で伝説のポケモンの報告が相次いでる中、待ってる余裕なんてなかったから……

key: You get what you pay for, I guess.
en: You get what you pay for, I guess.
ja: 安かろう悪かろう、ってところかしらね。

key: Nothing more can be expected from these bottom-of- the-bargain-bin foreigners.
en: Nothing more can be expected from these bottom-of- the-bargain-bin foreigners.
ja: こんな二束三文の外国人たちに、これ以上を期待する方が無理よ。

key: But once I have this Pokémon-- a Mythical like this valued for its speed and attack power...
en: But once I have this Pokémon-- a Mythical like this valued for its speed and attack power...
ja: でも、このポケモンさえ手に入れば――速さと攻撃力で評価されてる、こんな幻のポケモン……

key: It'll be worth millions! And a powerhouse to boot.
en: It'll be worth millions! And a powerhouse to boot.
ja: 何百万もの価値になるわ! しかもとんでもない実力も手に入る。

key: Notice it's not zipping around now like before.
en: Notice it's not zipping around now like before.
ja: もう前みたいに素早く動き回ってないの、わかるでしょ。

key: It's because it knows.
en: It's because it knows.
ja: それはこいつがわかってるからよ。

key: In the face of true power-- born leadership and control like mine-- any Pokémon would submit!
en: In the face of true power-- born leadership and control like mine-- any Pokémon would submit!
ja: 真の力を前にすれば――あたしのような生まれついてのリーダーシップと支配力を前にすれば――どんなポケモンだって従うものよ!

key: It's only natural, after all-- a Pokémon like this suits someone like me.
en: It's only natural, after all-- a Pokémon like this suits someone like me.
ja: 何しろ当然のことよね――こういうポケモンは、あたしみたいな人間にこそふさわしいの。

key: Mythical-- a class above everyone else!
en: Mythical-- a class above everyone else!
ja: 幻のポケモン――みんなより一段上の存在よ!

key: A lowborn such as yourself wouldn't understand, but you must have brought some strong pokemon.
en: A lowborn such as yourself wouldn't understand, but you must have brought some strong pokemon.
ja: あんたみたいな身分の低い人間にはわからないでしょうけど、それなりに強いポケモンは連れてきてるんでしょうね。

key: Maybe I'll take them along with this Zeraora once I'm done.
en: Maybe I'll take them along with this Zeraora once I'm done.
ja: こいつが片づいたら、あんたのポケモンもついでにいただこうかしら。

key: This is my lucky day!
en: This is my lucky day!
ja: 今日はついてるわ!

key: Enough!
en: Enough!
ja: もう十分だ!

key: SHANNON: Ugh! To hell with it!
en: SHANNON: Ugh! To hell with it!
ja: シャノン: くっ! もうどうにでもなれ!

key: I'm cutting my losses... I hope this beast rips you to pieces!
en: I'm cutting my losses... I hope this beast rips you to pieces!
ja: 損切りするわ……このけだものにズタズタにされちゃえばいいのよ!

key: Zeraora is badly injured.
en: Zeraora is badly injured.
ja: ゼラオラはひどく傷ついている。

key: ARC: All right, step aside. Medic coming through.
en: ARC: All right, step aside. Medic coming through.
ja: アーク: よし、どいてろ。衛生兵の通り道だ。

key: ARC: Medic might be a strong word-- but let's see if we can't jump start Zeraora's batteries.
en: ARC: Medic might be a strong word-- but let's see if we can't jump start Zeraora's batteries.
ja: アーク: 衛生兵は言い過ぎかもしれねえが、ゼラオラのバッテリーをブースト始動できるか試してみよう。

key: Jolteon, put that Volt Absorb to work!
en: Jolteon, put that Volt Absorb to work!
ja: サンダース、ちくでんの出番だ!

key: BRESLIN: Shame that wouldn't work on Ein.
en: BRESLIN: Shame that wouldn't work on Ein.
ja: ブレスリン: それがアインに効かないのが残念だな。

key: ARC: No need for sparks-- some TLC and time off and he'll be just fine.
en: ARC: No need for sparks-- some TLC and time off and he'll be just fine.
ja: アーク: 火花はいらねえ――しっかり手当てして休ませりゃ、こいつは大丈夫だ。

key: BRESLIN: The rest of the crew's safe and extracted thanks to you as well.
en: BRESLIN: The rest of the crew's safe and extracted thanks to you as well.
ja: ブレスリン: 残りのクルーも、お前のおかげで無事に救出できた。

key: ARC: We saw that woman tumbling face-first into the woods just now.
en: ARC: We saw that woman tumbling face-first into the woods just now.
ja: アーク: あの女がさっき、顔から森に突っ込んでくのを見たぜ。

key: Seems like she lives at the crossroads between inelegance and catastrophe.
en: Seems like she lives at the crossroads between inelegance and catastrophe.
ja: 優雅さのなさと大惨事の交差点に住んでるような女だな。

key: BRESLIN: Bit of an understatement, there.
en: BRESLIN: Bit of an understatement, there.
ja: ブレスリン: それは控えめすぎる表現だな。

key: My team and I really appreciate your help, \PN.
en: My team and I really appreciate your help, \PN.
ja: 俺たちのチーム一同、本当に助かった、\PN。

key: We've also been talking since this all started, and we're thinking about rebranding ourselves.
en: We've also been talking since this all started, and we're thinking about rebranding ourselves.
ja: それと、これが始まってからずっと話してたんだが、自分たちの看板を変えようかと思ってる。

key: Something like noble poachers,
en: Something like noble poachers,
ja: 高潔な密猟者、みたいなやつをな。

key: Stealin' from those who want to cage and abuse Pokémon...
en: Stealin' from those who want to cage and abuse Pokémon...
ja: ポケモンをおりに入れて虐待しようとする連中から奪う、っていう……

key: Nothing's set in stone yet, but it's an idea.
en: Nothing's set in stone yet, but it's an idea.
ja: まだ何も決まってないが、一つのアイデアだ。

key: ARC: A better direction, to be sure.
en: ARC: A better direction, to be sure.
ja: アーク: 確かに、その方が良い方向だな。

key: BRESLIN: I'll let you know what we decide.
en: BRESLIN: I'll let you know what we decide.
ja: ブレスリン: 決まったら知らせるよ。

key: Maybe stop by that Nightclub of yours from time to time.
en: Maybe stop by that Nightclub of yours from time to time.
ja: あんたのナイトクラブにも、時々顔を出すかもな。

key: Heard it's fancy-- maybe even a good place to train.
en: Heard it's fancy-- maybe even a good place to train.
ja: しゃれてるって聞いたし――鍛えるのにもいい場所かもな。

key: Especially if the Champion might be around.
en: Especially if the Champion might be around.
ja: 特にチャンピオンがいるかもしれないなら、なおさらだ。

key: For now, I'll leave you two to the catch.
en: For now, I'll leave you two to the catch.
ja: とりあえず、捕獲は二人に任せるよ。

key: We've no business with it anymore anyway.
en: We've no business with it anymore anyway.
ja: どのみち、俺たちにはもう関係のないことだしな。

key: Good luck!
en: Good luck!
ja: 頑張れよ!

key: ARC: Well, someone's feeling better.
en: ARC: Well, someone's feeling better.
ja: アーク: おっと、誰かさん、調子が良くなってきたみたいだな。

key: ZERAORA: Ora!
en: ZERAORA: Ora!
ja: ゼラオラ: オラ!

key: ARC: ...And it sounds like it wants to go with you.
en: ARC: ...And it sounds like it wants to go with you.
ja: アーク: ……で、お前についていきたがってるみたいだぜ。

key: I guess you earned its respect in that whole ordeal.
en: I guess you earned its respect in that whole ordeal.
ja: あの試練の中で、こいつの信頼を勝ち取ったってことだな。

key: Just as well-- it's likely safer with you than staying wild and a potential target for that woman.
en: Just as well-- it's likely safer with you than staying wild and a potential target for that woman.
ja: その方がいいだろう――野生のままあの女の標的になり続けるより、お前と一緒にいる方が安全だろうしな。

key: ZERAORA: Zerrra!
en: ZERAORA: Zerrra!
ja: ゼラオラ: ゼラアア!

key: ARC: That okay with you?
en: ARC: That okay with you?
ja: アーク: それでいいのか?

key: ZERAORA: Razza!!
en: ZERAORA: Razza!!
ja: ゼラオラ: ラッザ!!

key: ARC: What, you really don't want it?
en: ARC: What, you really don't want it?
ja: アーク: なんだ、本当に要らないのか?

key: Can't say I understand it, but I'll respect your decision in turn.
en: Can't say I understand it, but I'll respect your decision in turn.
ja: 理解できるとは言えねえが、お前の決断は尊重するぜ。

key: You sure about that?
en: You sure about that?
ja: 本当にそれでいいんだな?

key: ARC: All right, if that's what you want.
en: ARC: All right, if that's what you want.
ja: アーク: わかった、それがお前の望みならな。

key: In that case, Zeraora, you mind tagging along with me instead?
en: In that case, Zeraora, you mind tagging along with me instead?
ja: だったら、ゼラオラ、代わりに俺についてくるか?

key: I'll keep you safe and sound just the same, sure as the sun shines.
en: I'll keep you safe and sound just the same, sure as the sun shines.
ja: 太陽が輝くのと同じくらい確かに、お前を無事に守ってやるぜ。

key: ARC: Thought as much.
en: ARC: Thought as much.
ja: アーク: だと思ったぜ。

key: It's all yours, then.
en: It's all yours, then.
ja: じゃあ、お前のもんだ。

key: ARC: Sounds like that's a wrap, then.
en: ARC: Sounds like that's a wrap, then.
ja: アーク: これで一段落ってわけだな。

key: Thanks for tuning into this one with me.
en: Thanks for tuning into this one with me.
ja: 今回も付き合ってくれてありがとな。

key: I think we did some good here.
en: I think we did some good here.
ja: ここでいいことができたと思うぜ。

key: You ready to head back to the club already?
en: You ready to head back to the club already?
ja: もうクラブに戻る準備はできてるか?

key: ARC: Roger that; let's be off.
en: ARC: Roger that; let's be off.
ja: アーク: 了解だ、行こうぜ。

key: ARC: Then it's 'till next time.
en: ARC: Then it's 'till next time.
ja: アーク: じゃ、また今度な。

key: Pichu is trapped in the cage...
en: Pichu is trapped in the cage...
ja: ピチューがおりに閉じ込められている……

key: Geodude is trapped in the cage...
en: Geodude is trapped in the cage...
ja: イシツブテがおりに閉じ込められている……

key: Capture the weak ones to lure out the strong...
en: Capture the weak ones to lure out the strong...
ja: 弱いのを捕まえて、強いのをおびき出す……

key: Now we just gotta wait for it--
en: Now we just gotta wait for it--
ja: あとは待つだけだ――

key: Oh, right, gotta try and stop you too!
en: Oh, right, gotta try and stop you too!
ja: ああ、そうだ、お前も止めないとな!

key: All right, you win for now... I was going easy on you anyway, 'cause you're cute.
en: All right, you win for now... I was going easy on you anyway, 'cause you're cute.
ja: よし、今回はお前の勝ちだ……どうせ手加減してたしな、かわいいから。

key: Man, that speed is incredible!
en: Man, that speed is incredible!
ja: いやあ、あのスピード、たまげたぜ!

key: Strong, too--
en: Strong, too--
ja: 強くもあるしな――

key: It rescued the Pokémon in an instant just like that...
en: It rescued the Pokémon in an instant just like that...
ja: あっという間にポケモンを助け出しちまった……

key: Well, I guess there's nothing to do but head on out, huh?
en: Well, I guess there's nothing to do but head on out, huh?
ja: まあ、あとは出ていくしかねえよな?

key: You've still got some work to do, don't you?
en: You've still got some work to do, don't you?
ja: お前にはまだやることが残ってるんだろ?

key: Go easy on Willow, will you?
en: Go easy on Willow, will you?
ja: ウィローには手加減してやってくれよな?

key: She's kinda in a slump these days.
en: She's kinda in a slump these days.
ja: 最近ちょっとスランプ気味なんだ。

key: See that broken bridge directly across from here? She's on the other side. Someone should really fix that.
en: See that broken bridge directly across from here?  She's on the other side. Someone should really fix that.
ja: ここの真向かいに壊れた橋が見えるだろ? 彼女は向こう側にいる。誰かちゃんと直すべきだよな。

key: I'm pretty sure the number one cause of injuries is people falling over broken ancient ruin bridges.
en: I'm pretty sure the number one cause of injuries is people falling over broken ancient ruin bridges.
ja: 怪我の原因ナンバーワンは、間違いなく古い遺跡の壊れた橋から落ちることだと思うぜ。

key: The client's probably still waiting somewhere northeast.
en: The client's probably still waiting somewhere northeast.
ja: 依頼主はたぶん、まだ北東のどこかで待ってるはずだ。

key: She's a beauty-- and a brute.
en: She's a beauty-- and a brute.
ja: 美人で――そして荒くれ者だ。

key: See ya!
en: See ya!
ja: またな!

key: FERN: Ugh, get back here, you stupid pixie!
en: FERN: Ugh, get back here, you stupid pixie!
ja: ファーン: くそ、戻ってこい、このバカ妖精め!

key: FERN: Now I've got you!
en: FERN: Now I've got you!
ja: ファーン: 捕まえたぞ!

key: If you were just going to get cornered anyway, you may as well have saved me the trouble and not bothered running!
en: If you were just going to get cornered anyway, you may as well have saved me the trouble and not bothered running!
ja: どうせ追い詰められるんなら、最初から逃げずにオレ様の手間を省いてくれりゃよかったのにな!

key: MEW: Mew?
en: MEW: Mew?
ja: ミュウ: ミュウ?

key: FERN: Don't you mew at me!
en: FERN: Don't you mew at me!
ja: ファーン: オレ様にミュウとか鳴くんじゃねえ!

key: I've had enough of being embarrassed by you and your antics!
en: I've had enough of being embarrassed by you and your antics!
ja: お前とお前の悪ふざけに恥をかかされるのは、もううんざりだ!

key: MEW: Mewmewmew~
en: MEW: Mewmewmew~
ja: ミュウ: ミュウミュウミュウ~

key: FERN: That's it! You're mine!
en: FERN: That's it! You're mine!
ja: ファーン: よし! お前はオレ様のもんだ!

key: FERN: Don't even think about it!
en: FERN: Don't even think about it!
ja: ファーン: そんなこと考えるんじゃねえ!

key: FERN: That's right, just let it happen...
en: FERN: That's right, just let it happen...
ja: ファーン: そうだ、そのまま観念しろ……

key: MEW: Mew!
en: MEW: Mew!
ja: ミュウ: ミュウ!

key: FERN: Ugh, not again...
en: FERN: Ugh, not again...
ja: ファーン: くそ、またかよ……

key: Get back here already!
en: Get back here already!
ja: いい加減戻ってこい!

key: FERN: Ugh... That one hurt.
en: FERN: Ugh... That one hurt.
ja: ファーン: うっ……今のは効いたな。

key: FERN: Hey, uh... \PN.
en: FERN: Hey, uh... \PN.
ja: ファーン: なあ、その……\PN。

key: I think I'm locked in here...
en: I think I'm locked in here...
ja: ここに閉じ込められちまったみたいなんだが……

key: Do you, uh... mind coming down here and letting me out?
en: Do you, uh... mind coming down here and letting me out?
ja: その……ここまで下りてきて、出してもらえねえか?

key: FERN: Could you... maybe, come down here and let me out?
en: FERN: Could you... maybe, come down here and let me out?
ja: ファーン: その……ここまで下りてきて、出してもらえねえか?

key: There's probably a switch by or on the door...
en: There's probably a switch by or on the door...
ja: たぶん扉のそばか、扉自体にスイッチがあるはずだ……

key: There must be, right?
en: There must be, right?
ja: あるはずだよな?

key: CAL: Well, let's go ahead and get started.
en: CAL: Well, let's go ahead and get started.
ja: キャル: それじゃ、始めるとするか。

key: Now that we've settled on a site, we'll each do proper introductions.
en: Now that we've settled on a site, we'll each do proper introductions.
ja: 場所も決まったし、それぞれちゃんと自己紹介しよう。

key: Afterwards we can get the tents up and take a rest.
en: Afterwards we can get the tents up and take a rest.
ja: そのあとテントを張って、休憩といこう。

key: Let's each of us begin by saying who we are, and what we hope to get out of this week.
en: Let's each of us begin by saying who we are, and what we hope to get out of this week.
ja: まずは、自分が何者か、そしてこの一週間で何を得たいか、一人ずつ話していこう。

key: For my part, I'm someone who's just learning to take the first true steps towards agency and peace.
en: For my part, I'm someone who's just learning to take the first true steps towards agency and peace.
ja: 俺自身について言えば、自分の意志と平穏に向けて、本当の第一歩をようやく学び始めたところだ。

key: I've got a lot of self-discovery left to do, which is why I'm grateful, not just for the chance to be here,
en: I've got a lot of self-discovery left to do, which is why I'm grateful, not just for the chance to be here,
ja: 自己発見の道のりはまだまだ残ってる。だからこそ、ここにいられる機会だけじゃなく、

key: But for the chance to lead this trip, and have some of my closest friends alongside me during it.
en: But for the chance to lead this trip, and have some of my closest friends alongside me during it.
ja: この旅を導く機会と、その中に一番親しい友人たちがいてくれることにも、感謝してるんだ。

key: I hope that by the end of this week, I have a clearer picture of myself disconnected from the recent chaotic events,
en: I hope that by the end of this week, I have a clearer picture of myself disconnected from the recent chaotic events,
ja: この一週間が終わる頃には、最近の混乱した出来事から切り離された、もっとはっきりした自分の姿が見えているといい。

key: And that I will have earned the genuine trust and vulnerability of each of you, both as an individual and a leader in the Academy.
en: And that I will have earned the genuine trust and vulnerability of each of you, both as an individual and a leader in the Academy.
ja: そして、アカデミーの一個人としても、リーダーとしても、みんな一人一人から本物の信頼と心を開いてもらえる関係を築けているといいな。

key: LETTIE: I still can't believe Victoria picked YOU.
en: LETTIE: I still can't believe Victoria picked YOU.
ja: レティ: ヴィクトリアが「あんた」を選んだなんて、いまだに信じられないんだけど。

key: CAL: I can hardly believe it myself, so I understand your concerns.
en: CAL: I can hardly believe it myself, so I understand your concerns.
ja: キャル: 俺自身、正直まだ信じられないくらいだから、その気持ちはわかるよ。

key: But despite-- or, perhaps because of-- my past, I have the sincere belief that I can give my all to Apophyll Academy and live up to the opportunity.
en: But despite-- or, perhaps because of-- my past, I have the sincere belief that I can give my all to Apophyll Academy and live up to the opportunity.
ja: でも、俺の過去にもかかわらず――いや、むしろその過去があるからこそ――アポフィルアカデミーに全力を尽くして、この機会に応えられると本気で信じてるんだ。

key: Now, who would like to go next?
en: Now, who would like to go next?
ja: さて、次は誰がいく?

key: PRESTON: Sure, I'll go.
en: PRESTON: Sure, I'll go.
ja: プレストン: よし、俺がいくよ。

key: My name's Preston, and I'm hoping to just have a nice week out in nature and unwind for a bit.
en: My name's Preston, and I'm hoping to just have a nice week out in nature and unwind for a bit.
ja: 俺の名前はプレストン。自然の中で気持ちのいい一週間を過ごして、ちょっとリラックスできればと思ってる。

key: CAL: And who are you?
en: CAL: And who are you?
ja: キャル: それで、君は何者だ?

key: PRESTON: I... just said, my name's Preston.
en: PRESTON: I... just said, my name's Preston.
ja: プレストン: い、今言っただろ、俺の名前はプレストンだって。

key: CAL: I'm not asking for your name.
en: CAL: I'm not asking for your name.
ja: キャル: 名前を聞いてるんじゃない。

key: Who are you?
en: Who are you?
ja: 君は何者なんだ?

key: PRESTON: Uhh...
en: PRESTON: Uhh...
ja: プレストン: ええと……

key: Well, I work as a system manager for a preservation initiative on Azurine Island--
en: Well, I work as a system manager for a preservation initiative on Azurine Island--
ja: その、俺はアズリン島の保全プロジェクトでシステム管理者として働いてて――

key: CAL: Is your profession who you are?
en: CAL: Is your profession who you are?
ja: キャル: 職業が、君という人間なのか?

key: PRESTON: I--
en: PRESTON: I--
ja: プレストン: 俺は――

key: Man, what do you want from me here?
en: Man, what do you want from me here?
ja: なあ、俺に何を求めてるんだよ?

key: CAL: I apologize if I'm coming on strong here, but you've fallen for the trap.
en: CAL: I apologize if I'm coming on strong here, but you've fallen for the trap.
ja: キャル: 強く出すぎたなら悪いが、君はそのわなにはまってしまったんだ。

key: "System manager" may be your job title.
en: "System manager" may be your job title.
ja: 「システム管理者」は、君の肩書きかもしれない。

key: But-- and you can answer 'yes' to this, if you'd like-- is it who you are?
en: But-- and you can answer 'yes' to this, if you'd like-- is it who you are?
ja: だが――「はい」と答えたいなら、それでもいい――それは君という人間そのものなのか?

key: Who you want to represent yourself as?
en: Who you want to represent yourself as?
ja: 君が自分をそう表したいと思っている姿なのか?

key: Or is it just a summative label of how you spend your time under the notion that one's profession is the thing most people want to know about you?
en: Or is it just a summative label of how you spend your time under the notion that one's profession is the thing most people want to know about you?
ja: それとも、「たいていの人は職業を知りたがるものだ」という考えのもとで、自分の時間の使い方をまとめただけのラベルにすぎないのか?

key: PRESTON: I, uh...
en: PRESTON: I, uh...
ja: プレストン: 俺は、その……

key: Well, shit.
en: Well, shit.
ja: まあ、くそ。

key: CAL: Take your time. It is not an easy question.
en: CAL: Take your time. It is not an easy question.
ja: キャル: ゆっくりでいい。簡単な問いじゃないからな。

key: But if we can't be faithful to ourselves in how we represent ourselves, how can we hope for anyone else to see us faithfully?
en: But if we can't be faithful to ourselves in how we represent ourselves, how can we hope for anyone else to see us faithfully?
ja: でも、自分自身を表す時に、自分に誠実になれないなら、他の誰かに誠実に見てもらえるなんて、どうして望めるだろう?

key: The work begins now.
en: The work begins now.
ja: その作業は、今始まる。

key: SHELLY: Sorry that took so long! I got the rest of the firewood!
en: SHELLY: Sorry that took so long! I got the rest of the firewood!
ja: シェリー: 遅くなってごめん! 残りの薪、取ってきたよ!

key: ARC: Looks like I pulled ahead of you somewhere along the way.
en: ARC: Looks like I pulled ahead of you somewhere along the way.
ja: アーク: どうやら、途中でお前を追い抜いちまったみたいだな。

key: Ein is safe, no sweat.
en: Ein is safe, no sweat.
ja: アインは無事だ、心配ねえ。

key: Breslin's taking care of him, and I'll be popping back to check on them in short order.
en: Breslin's taking care of him, and I'll be popping back to check on them in short order.
ja: ブレスリンが面倒見てるし、俺もすぐに様子を見に戻るつもりだ。

key: Just thought I'd take a brief survey of how things are out here.
en: Just thought I'd take a brief survey of how things are out here.
ja: こっちの状況をちょっと見ておこうと思ってな。

key: The rest of their team isn't far.
en: The rest of their team isn't far.
ja: 残りの連中も、そう遠くにいないはずだ。

key: They've scattered through this area caging 'Mons left and right.
en: They've scattered through this area caging 'Mons left and right.
ja: この辺りに散らばって、あちこちでポケモンをおりに入れてる。

key: Downright deplorable.
en: Downright deplorable.
ja: まったくもって、けしからんことだぜ。

key: It's all you, \PN.
en: It's all you, \PN.
ja: あとは任せた、\PN。

key: I'm on support if you need a tune-up.
en: I'm on support if you need a tune-up.
ja: 調整が必要ならサポートするぜ。

key: ARC: Let me brush you up.
en: ARC: Let me brush you up.
ja: アーク: ちょっと調整してやろう。

key: Not a problem for me.
en: Not a problem for me.
ja: 俺には造作もないことだ。

key: Got plenty of experience taking care of my folks.
en: Got plenty of experience taking care of my folks.
ja: 自分の連中の面倒を見るのには、慣れてるからな。

key: Let me see the squad.
en: Let me see the squad.
ja: パーティを見せてくれ。

key: Seems like I'm only on nursing duty today.
en: Seems like I'm only on nursing duty today.
ja: 今日は看護係専門ってわけらしいな。

key: ARC: Up and at 'em, champ.
en: ARC: Up and at 'em, champ.
ja: アーク: さあ行くぞ、チャンプ。

key: Ah, a seasoned Trainer! Up for a challenge?
en: Ah, a seasoned Trainer! Up for a challenge?
ja: おお、熟練のトレーナーだな! 挑戦する気はあるか?

key: Impressive! Perhaps we'll meet again somewhere...
en: Impressive! Perhaps we'll meet again somewhere...
ja: 見事だ! またどこかで会えるかもな……

key: We both have our own aspirations to chase after, don't we?
en: We both have our own aspirations to chase after, don't we?
ja: お互い、追い求める目標があるってわけだ、だろ?

key: You look like a time and a half!
en: You look like a time and a half!
ja: お前、1.5倍は強そうに見えるぜ!

key: Maybe even two times at this rate!
en: Maybe even two times at this rate!
ja: この調子だと、2倍かもな!

key: Stay safe out here, friend.
en: Stay safe out here, friend.
ja: ここでは気をつけてな、相棒。

key: Not many get to travel this far off the beaten road.
en: Not many get to travel this far off the beaten road.
ja: こんなに人里離れたとこまで来られる奴は、そう多くない。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
